verse.verse_1: Have We not opened forth for thee thy breast?
verse.verse_2: And We have taken off from thee thy burthen,
verse.verse_4: And We have upraised for thee thy renown.
verse.verse_5: Then verily along with every hardship is ease.
verse.verse_6: Verily along with every hardship is ease.
verse.verse_7: Then when thou becometh relieved, toil;
